# Outreach leads, Tuesday, November 17, 2026

- **Indivi**, acquisition: Swiss neurotech company Indivi acquired Imperial College London spin-out Cogitat to advance AI-powered brain monitoring and digital biomarkers. Directly focuses on machine learning algorithms applied to EEG and brain monitoring data for clinical neurotech applications. [source](https://news.google.?oc=5)
- **Precision Neuroscience** (NYC), partnership: Precision Neuroscience partnered with Team Gleason to integrate ALS patient insights into the development and testing of its brain-computer interface system. Develops high-channel micro-ECoG cortical surface arrays and biosignal decoding pipelines for motor and communication neuroprosthetics. [source](https://news.google.?oc=5)
- **University of Texas at Austin (Wang Lab)**, research: Researchers developed NEUSLeeP, a wearable soft patch combining noninvasive ultrasound deep-brain stimulation with real-time EEG monitoring to enhance REM sleep. Combines noninvasive closed-loop neuromodulation hardware with real-time electrophysiological biosignal monitoring. [source](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMib0FVX3lxTE1tdUpFV0tZaWtScmZZUFNEYkswYXdhZW5JR3plMkN0RFpjaWkxZURiOGZTemlwS2xNVDlTbkstLVhxX1NVWkN0ZTJlU2o0eG1lZmJydVN0dXU0aTZLamczWjk5YXJsSndaQ1drSmJXaw?oc=5)
- **Memoket**, funding: AI wearable hardware startup Memoket secured $4.5 million in Pre-A funding. Provides opportunities in on-device AI algorithms and physiological sensor data processing for emerging wearable systems. [source](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMimgFBVV95cUxNaUhpcm0wWnRldk9VTlBOblUtdTVHTTFJVUJyU3NHM0Z5YXB6c2NFV0FuelJldGpyMnppTUJVWlp0SkE5MG1HaDRPbHpjM1RmM1JOejBSbHl5cjFGZXdmM2w2bXlVcmc0VFJDQVp3MFBIYldwQnBZOWFzcVRXQVlZaWI4aUVzazZrbkxQeWNGbEtJdFU1LVFYNmJn?oc=5)
- **Noom** (NYC), expansion: Noom launched Noom Band, a connected health wearable integrating Sensor Bio's raw PPG, HRV, and sleep signal analytics pipeline for rollout in 2027. Involves processing raw optical photoplethysmography and inertial biosignals to derive HRV, respiration, and sleep metrics. [source](https://news.google.?oc=5)
- **Tandem Diabetes Care**, fda: Tandem Diabetes Care earned FDA clearance for its tubeless automated insulin delivery system ahead of a planned 2027 launch. Represents commercial closed-loop bio-control systems combining continuous physiological sensing with automated algorithmic delivery. [source](https://www.medtechdive.com/news/tandem-wins-fda-clearance-for-tubeless-automated-insulin-delivery-system/874718/)
- **MiniMed**, fda: MiniMed received FDA clearance for its Fit tubeless patch insulin pump for automated glycemic management. Offers experience in wearable therapeutic delivery systems that interface with continuous biosensing data streams. [source](https://www.medtechdive.com/news/minimed-gets-fda-nod-for-tubeless-insulin-pump/874766/)
- **Viz.ai**, partnership: Viz.ai partnered with Wolters Kluwer to integrate clinical decision support capabilities directly into its AI-powered neurovascular imaging workflow. Applies deep learning computer vision to neuroimaging signals for real-time stroke and neurological crisis detection. [source](https://news.google.?oc=5)
- **Medtronic**, acquisition: Medtronic agreed to acquire peripheral and carotid intervention company Contego Medical for $380 million. Medtronic is the largest industry developer of active implantable neuromodulation systems, deep brain stimulation, and neurovascular tech. [source](https://www.medtechdive.com/news/medtronic-to-buy-contego-medical-for-380m/874754/)
- **Remedy Robotics**, funding: Remedy Robotics raised $62 million in a Series B round to advance clinical trials for its robotic telesurgical intervention system. Engages robotic controls, sensorized instrumentation, and teleoperation relevant to medical device mechatronics and surgical navigation. [source](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiswFBVV95cUxOYzlnSi1oZnlLbnh1bnAtS0NHQ1M0a2FCaHVaZlkxM2VhalZCN2taanlBVHJsU0tmcFdZTk11NmR5OTN2LWxSd1pFT0ZFT29qZ21tSzU2STZVWjZURFBxVFRrdzhaenhWYUswQWpJWDdzMFNEMTNTWjFZVHYwdElNMTRuaEN5UTAwWE85ZmZ2ZVdLSTRBVXpTOS01bW9CMGJsQk9rc1JKWWRWSzhQSXVLTFBvdw?oc=5)
- **OpenEvidence**, partnership: OpenEvidence collaborated with Apple to launch a clinical conversational health AI study and companion research application. Explores clinical AI deployment and consumer health interfaces tied to digital health and wearable ecosystem data. [source](https://www.medtechdive.com/news/apple-openevidence-conversational-health-ai-study-app/874780/)
